mesh_node_ids.semantics: Row IDs for mesh_coordinates. Coordinate records include non-solid solver nodes; they are not displacement row IDs.

mesh_coordinates.semantics: Coordinate row j belongs to mesh_node_ids[j]. Native global X,Y,Z coordinates.

displacement_node_ids.semantics: Only physical nodes connected to 3D solid elements. Row IDs for displacement_native.

displacement_native.semantics: Row k belongs to displacement_node_ids[k], global components [Ux,Uy,Uz]. Generalized joint/pilot DOFs have been excluded.

stress_node_ids.semantics: Only physical 3D-solid node IDs. Row IDs for von_mises_native; join by ID, not by row number across arrays.

von_mises_native.semantics: DPF Nodal von Mises stress. Row k belongs to stress_node_ids[k].

critical_alignment_rule: displacement_native[k] belongs to displacement_node_ids[k]. Look up its coordinate by matching that ID in mesh_node_ids. Never pair displacement_native rows directly with mesh_coordinates row positions.
coordinate_id_check_evidence: Both final exports independently checked: coordinate IDs absent from physical displacement are 1229420 through 1229433 (14 records).
rounding: Native values are float64 in NPZ; rendered VTP boundary coordinates use float32 for display only.
